subject: math
question:
设 $f(x)$ 是定义在 R 上且以 T > 0 为周期的连续函数，证明：

$$
\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} n \int_ {n} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {f (x)}{x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{T} \int_ {0} ^ {T} f (x) \mathrm{d} x.
$$
answer: 收敛，所以 $\int_{n}^{+\infty} \frac{f(x)}{x^2} \mathrm{d}x$ 是绝对收敛的. 因而

steps.text:
分析 从左、右两端的积分形式来看，左端被积函数的分母不能保留，并且积分区间要用 $f(x)$ 的周期来分段。为了将左端被积函数的分母移出积分号，只能将分母在每个周期段做放大与缩小，求极限时利用夹逼原理来得到等式。

因为 $f(x)$ 是连续的周期函数，故必有最大与最小值. 记 $M = \max_{0 \leqslant x \leqslant T} |f(x)|$ ，则有 $\left|\frac{f(x)}{x^2}\right| \leqslant \frac{M}{x^2}$ . 由于积分 $\int_{n}^{+\infty} \frac{1}{x^2} \mathrm{d}x$ 收敛，所以 $\int_{n}^{+\infty} \frac{f(x)}{x^2} \mathrm{d}x$ 是绝对收敛的. 因而

$$
n \int_ {n} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {f (x)}{x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x = \lim _ {m \rightarrow \infty} n \int_ {n} ^ {n + m T} \frac {f (x)}{x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x = \lim _ {m \rightarrow \infty} n \sum_ {k = 0} ^ {m - 1} \int_ {n + k T} ^ {n + (k + 1) T} \frac {f (x)}{x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x (m \in \mathbb {N}).\tag{①}
$$

不妨设 $f(x)$ 非负，否则可用 $f(x) + M$ 去替换. 因为

$$
n \sum_ {k = 0} ^ {m - 1} \frac {1}{(n + (k + 1) T) ^ {2}} \int_ {0} ^ {T} f (x) d x \leqslant n \sum_ {k = 0} ^ {m - 1} \int_ {n + k T} ^ {n + (k + 1) T} \frac {f (x)}{x ^ {2}} d x \leqslant n \sum_ {k = 0} ^ {m - 1} \frac {1}{(n + k T) ^ {2}} \int_ {0} ^ {T} f (x) d x,\tag{②}
$$

而

$$
\begin{array}{r l} n \sum_ {k = 0} ^ {m - 1} \frac {1}{(n + (k + 1) T) ^ {2}} & = n \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {m} \frac {1}{(n + k T) ^ {2}} > n \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {m} \int_ {k} ^ {k + 1} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{(n + x T) ^ {2}} \\ & = n \int_ {1} ^ {m + 1} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{(n + x T) ^ {2}} = \frac {n}{T} \left(\frac {1}{n + T} - \frac {1}{n + (m + 1) T}\right), \end{array}\tag{③}

n \sum_ {k = 0} ^ {m - 1} \frac {1}{(n + k T) ^ {2}} <   \frac {1}{n} + n \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {m} \int_ {k - 1} ^ {k} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{(n + x T) ^ {2}} = \frac {1}{n} + n \int_ {0} ^ {m} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{(n + x T) ^ {2}} = \frac {1}{n} + \frac {n}{T} \left(\frac {1}{n} - \frac {1}{n + m T}\right).\tag{④}
$$

将③，④式代入②式得

$$
\frac {n}{T} \left(\frac {1}{n + T} - \frac {1}{n + (m + 1) T}\right) \int_ {0} ^ {T} f (x) d x \leqslant n \sum_ {k = 0} ^ {m - 1} \int_ {n + k T} ^ {n + (k + 1) T} \frac {f (x)}{x ^ {2}} d x \leqslant \left[ \frac {1}{n} + \frac {n}{T} \left(\frac {1}{n} - \frac {1}{n + m T}\right) \right] \int_ {0} ^ {T} f (x) d x.
$$

取 $m \to \infty$ ，并由①式得

$$
\frac {n}{T (n + T)} \int_ {0} ^ {T} f (x) \mathrm{d} x \leqslant n \int_ {n} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {f (x)}{x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x \leqslant \left(\frac {1}{n} + \frac {1}{T}\right) \int_ {0} ^ {T} f (x) \mathrm{d} x,
$$

再取 $n \to \infty$ ，利用夹逼原理得

$$
\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} n \int_ {n} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {f (x)}{x ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{T} \int_ {0} ^ {T} f (x) \mathrm{d} x.
$$

meta.commentary:
评注（1）题解中处理 $f(x)$ 非负的方法值得借鉴.

(2) 注意周期函数的积分性质: $\int_{a}^{a + T} f(x) \mathrm{d}x = \int_{0}^{T} f(x) \mathrm{d}x$ .

(3) 该题结论也可改写为： $\lim_{n\to \infty}\int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{f(nx)}{x^2}\mathrm{d}x = \frac{1}{T}\int_0^T f(x)\mathrm{d}x.$
